answers.answer:
Mica work appears in F08_first_chat and F08_receipt_chat. In the first, the assistant planned to put the preview beside the working notes under “draft café 8.” In the receipt chat, the assistant believed publication was complete because the local preview finished; the user requested reopening the Mica foldout key because the archive acquired a cabinet of oversized folders. Publication is therefore only an assistant report in the supplied evidence. [R0002, R0001, R0003]

Willow archive crates belongs to F08_other_chat and is explicitly independent of Mica. Its requirements are to weigh each crate before transport and keep the work in planning until its own review. That continuing constraint makes Willow’s own review the condition for leaving planning. The status query recorded that Willow remained in planning and wrote no acceptance entry. [R0008, R0004, R0005, R0006, R0007]

Any separate continuing constraint for Mica, and its purpose, are unknown from the supplied spans.
uncertainties: The supplied spans do not state a continuing Mica constraint or its purpose.
Mica publication completion is not verified by an observed execution result in the supplied evidence.
